key_facts: The Florida Attorney General election was held in 2018, with voting on November 6, 2018.
The election was preceded by the 2014 Florida Attorney General election and followed by the 2022 election.
The Republican Party nominee was Ashley Moody.
The Democratic Party nominee was Sean Shaw.
The incumbent Attorney General before the election was Pam Bondi, a Republican.
